description: S15's ONE plugin read: what is installed, in which state, from where — and nothing that could be mistaken for a verb. There is no way to ask this reader to enable, disable, revoke or import: the four state transitions exist only in the CLI and the app, because a socket caller handed the means to install the thing that bypasses the guards is R6 refused (S10 said it for policy authoring, S12 for MCP servers). Nothing here was fetched — import takes a path and a scheme is refused before any disk is touched (AP10) — and zero imports is the normal state, which the note says without alarm (AP11). Revoked records stay listed when asked because a life that ended is a fact, not an embarrassment (AP4), and firstPartyCount counts the compiled bodies: the flag is the registry's to set, so a package's own claim appears nowhere except as its refusal (AP9).
